verdict.rationale: Chroma lets users control where data lives. It is Apache 2.0 and can run locally or self-hosted on the user's own infrastructure, and it offers a BYOC single-tenant option in the customer's own VPC with multi-cloud/multi-region replication. Missing for 10: documented region selection for managed Chroma Cloud, explicit data-residency or compliance guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of residency controls.
